app.name: FlavorQuest
app.tagline: Discover Vinh Khanh cuisine through audio

metadata.title: FlavorQuest - Discover Vinh Khanh Food Street
metadata.description: Automatic location-based audio tour of Vinh Khanh food street, Can Tho. Offline-first PWA with multi-language support.

manifest.description: Discover Vinh Khanh food street with location-based automatic audio narration. Supports 6 languages, works offline.

paywall.title: Pay to continue using FlavorQuest

description.beforeAmount: Customer accounts need a one-time payment of
description.afterAmount: to unlock the full app experience forever.

paywall.webhookHint: Access will be activated automatically via webhook. If the webhook is delayed, you can still check the payment status manually to sync immediately.
paywall.embeddedDescription: Pay directly on this page without leaving the app.
paywall.hostedDescription: Mobile/PWA uses the full payment page to avoid lag and frozen interactions.
paywall.embeddedInfo: After creating a payment, the embedded payOS checkout will appear here.
paywall.hostedInfo: On mobile and PWA, payOS embedded can freeze interactions because of WebView/iframe limits. FlavorQuest will open the full payOS payment page for a more stable experience.

messages.initial: Make a one-time payment of 20,000 VND to unlock the app forever.

messages.unauthorized: Your session has expired or is not ready yet. Please sign in again and continue the payment.
messages.accessGranted: Payment successful. Redirecting you into the app...
messages.cancelled: You cancelled the payment. You can create a new transaction anytime.
messages.expired: The payment link has expired. Please create a new transaction.

messages.statusCheckFailed: Unable to check payment status right now.
messages.createdPayment: Transaction created. Please scan the QR code or pay in the frame below.

success.descriptionBefore: Your payment has been confirmed. Your customer account is now unlocked

customer.title: Message the owner or admin directly
customer.subtitle: Each shop gets its own thread by location, while admin is the shared support channel for account and experience issues in FlavorQuest.
customer.emptyBody: Choose a shop or the admin channel on the left to start chatting. Email notifications will be sent when someone replies.

owner.title: Chat between owners and the support team
owner.subtitle: Keep customer conversations tied to each location and open a separate admin channel whenever operations need attention.
owner.emptyBody: When a customer messages a location or you open an admin channel, every conversation will appear here.

admin.title: Coordinate conversations with customers and owners
admin.subtitle: Admins receive customer and owner support threads in one inbox, so responses stay fast without relying on floating widgets.
admin.emptyBody: New support requests from customers or owners will appear here.

stats.activeThreadsBody: Each thread lives on its own full page instead of stacking over the main interface.
stats.unreadThreadsBody: Whenever a new message arrives, the recipient also gets an email notification.
